about: MGOGO parameter registry (docs/realism-design.md §4): every behavioral, ecological and demographic constant the simulation reads, with its plausible range, hard limits, evidence and sources. Human-edited, sorted by id. scripts/gen-params.ts validates it and writes src/sim/params.gen.ts. Planned entries document parameter constraints (P-*) whose mechanisms arrive in later stages.

Community centres are the compressed layout × this; the map and the stream use layoutScale. Field value from a rule stated before any run (docs/realism-design.md, C5a review response): the two neighbouring pairs (West–North, East–North) are tangent on average, i.e. centerScale = (rW + rN + rE + rN) / (dWN + dEN) with the field range radii and the compressed centre distances (83.23, 78.82) = 5,450 / 162.05 = 33.63. History: C5a swept it against T-IGE-1 (31.75 in the development run, 31.9 in the proof); that fit did not replicate on fresh seeds and is withdrawn (C5a review).

Stage C7b (field; docs/staging/c7b-prereg.md 3.2): at an episode's peak a crown is filled to f = cropFullMin + (1 - cropFullMin) u^this of its capacity, u = hash(tree, year; figs: cycle). 11.9 sets P(f > 1/2) = 0.1 among fruiting crowns: crowns more than half filled are at least 9x scarcer than other fruit-bearing crowns (janmaat2016; abstract, full text per the C7a review). k = ln((0.5 - 0.3) / 0.7) / ln 0.9. Mean fullness 0.354. 0 = off, every crown full at peak (compressed; the C7a field model).

Stage C7b (field; c7b-prereg 3.2): the least fullness of a fruiting crown at its peak, so the smallest crop capacity (~0.2) still reaches the feeding threshold (0.06, perception.ts) and every fruiting crown counts as fruiting. Design. Unused while cropFullExp is 0.

Stage C6: silent male travel was otherwise indistinguishable from patrols (C5a review).

Stage C7a (field): a trip to a remembered tree lasts the walking time plus 5 min instead of the travel bout, so it is not re-decided on the way (interrupts still apply). Travel to out-of-sight trees at Tai is near-linear, linearity 0.962 (normandBoesch2009). 0 = off (compressed).

Travel to a remembered tree: score falls by 1 per this many metres. Travel-cost scale (score falls by 1 per this many metres). Compressed literal before C5a; field value set for real distances between food patches (design, tuned to T-ACT-2 and T-RNG-4 in stage C5a). Field value tuned in C5a against T-ACT-2 and T-RNG-4 (with the cohesion weights); both targets are labelled tuned (C5a review). Stage C7a: field value 60,000 m, fitted against the two C12 statistics declared fitted (path per hour, Taï; same-day displacement, Ngogo) on proof seeds 48 and 7 (probes 2,000 / 6,000 / 20,000 / 60,000 m: 101 / 148 / 186 / 214 m/h, 0.20 / 0.29 / 0.31 / 0.34 km); the knob saturates below the field values. Distance then barely matters within a range, as field chimpanzees skip the nearest productive tree 70% of the time (normand2009). Stage C7b (c7b-prereg 2, C7a review finding 4): the 60,000 m fit switched the distance cost off; the field now values trips by intake rate (tripRateValue 1) and does not read this entry. Field value back to 2,000 m, its last in-range value (C5a-C6b), for runs with tripRateValue 0; the 60,000 m fit and its two fitted statistics are superseded.

Isopleths are computed from the UD smoothed by a Gaussian kernel of this σ (kernel home-range estimation; the observer uses a 95% fixed kernel for T-RNG-1; design). Stage C6b: in the field profile this is the upper bound of the reference bandwidth (udKernelRef).

Stage C6b: 1 = the UD kernel is the reference bandwidth of the community's own use (Worton 1989; the observer's estimator), h = sqrt((var x + var z)/2) x n^(-1/6) with n = udTauDays x 22 daylight half-hour fixes, between one cell and udKernelM; 0 = fixed udKernelM (compressed, unchanged). Makes the range record follow actual use (C12 comparison).
Only daytime party locations (daylight above this, parties not nesting) add to the UD: ranges are estimated from daytime use, not from night nests (design).

Own-range familiarity f in the territory cost is 1 inside the core (udCoreLevel) and falls linearly to 0 at this isopleth, as written in docs/realism-design.md §5.2 ("1 in the core, 0 outside the 99% isopleth"). Stage C6 first implemented f = 1 − level, which penalised everything outside the densest cell; corrected to the design text.
The range is the 95% isopleth of the UD (T-RNG methods; design).

The initial UD holds this many days of use, spread over the nominal circle (design). Stage C6b: field 3 days so the seeded circle is forgotten within weeks (C12 comparison: the record lagged actual use); compressed unchanged.
